title: zwiftverse — development handoff
text: R package wrapping three unofficial Zwift-ecosystem APIs (Zwift game, ZwiftPower, ZwiftRacing.app). Typed wrappers return tibbles; shared -disk TTL cache; roxygen docs; CI + pkgdown workflows; one vignette. done: structure, code, cache, NAMESPACE, tests (offline), CI YAML, pkgdown config, vignette. done — gate trusting anything: - Never run real R. Authored environment R toolchain, static-checked — R CMD check-clean, tests executed, never called live endpoint. - man/ generated (roxygen tags present; run devtools::document()). - Endpoint field names partly assumed (see Risks). vignette’s transmute()/hoist() column names placeholders pinned real responses. Treat v0.1.0 “compiles head, needs real run.”

what: Architecture (so you don’t have to reverse-engineer it)
title: zwiftverse — development handoff
text: R/cache.R::.zv_fetch(req, parse, ttl) single choke point. Every low-level accessor builds httr2 req hands . : bypasses parse="resp"; else computes cache key (method + url + body hash via rlang::hash), serves fresh cache hit, otherwise performs → parses JSON (simplifyVector/DataFrame + flatten) → caches → returns tbl/json. .zv_to_tbl() (R/utils.R): data.frame → tibble; {data:[...]} envelope unwrapped; bare array → row-bind; single object → one-row tibble nested fields list-columns (user tidyr::unnest_wider/hoist). Three auth models, one per file: zwift_auth() (OAuth2 handle, auto-refresh, env ZWIFT_USERNAME/PASSWORD); zp_session() + cookie (env creds SSO, pasted sid); zr_client() (static key, env ZR_AUTH). Typed wrappers forward ... low-level *_get, parse=/ttl= flow without per-wrapper plumbing. TTL semantics: 0=, Inf=permanent (immutable: completed results, historical epoch), n=seconds. Per-API defaults via options(zwiftverse.ttl_zwift/zp/zr).

title: zwiftverse — development handoff
text: Endpoints verified reading github.com/puckdoug/zpdatafetch (Python reference three APIs). Zwift game-API surface cross-referenced github.com/strukturunion-mmw/zwift-api-documentation. Nothing used leaked key — ZR wired user’s pending key.

title: zwiftverse — development handoff
text: Zwift + ZP auth use athlete’s real password, revocable token — never commit creds; use env vars keyring. Fixtures must PII-scrubbed. Data GDPR-consent-gated: non-consenting riders simply won’t appear; don’t treat absence error. Unofficial APIs: expect breakage upstream releases; fine personal/ research use, think harder anything redistributes others’ data.

title: Race analysis across Zwift, ZwiftPower and ZwiftRacing.app
text: zp_result() returns one row per finisher. ZwiftPower ships numbers [value, flag] pairs (arrive list-columns), run zp_unflag() first, pull rider id, finishing position category. Column names verified live responses (2026-11).
code: finishers <- res |>   zp_unflag() |>   transmute(     zwid     = as.integer(zwid),          # ZwiftPower rider id     name,     position = as.integer(position_in_cat),     category,     wkg_avg  = as.numeric(avg_wkg)   ) |>   arrange(category, position)  finishers

title: Race analysis across Zwift, ZwiftPower and ZwiftRacing.app
text: ZwiftRacing.app scores race, event endpoint already carries every finisher’s rating going race — per-rider lookups needed. zr_result() flattens pens one row per rider. ZwiftRacing keys events Zwift event id, usually number ZwiftPower id. column names verified live v2 API (2026-11). riders outside single race, zr_rider() returns current profile (vELO rating velo$race), zr_rider_overview() legacy live / max30 / max90 ratings:
code: zr <- zr_client()  ratings <- zr_result(zr, race_id) |>   transmute(     zwid       = as.integer(riderId),     zr_current = ratingBefore,          # ZR rating before the race     zr_after   = rating,                # ...and after it     zr_velo    = riderVelo.race         # vELO rating   )  ratings library(tidyr) zr_riders(zr, finishers$zwid[1:5]) |>      # one request per rider (no v2 batch)   hoist(velo, zr_velo = "race") |>   select(riderId, zr_velo)

title: Race analysis across Zwift, ZwiftPower and ZwiftRacing.app
text: Within category, higher pre-race rating go better finish? rank correlation honest summary — rating position ordinal relationship monotonic, linear. strong negative rho means favourites (higher rating) finished nearer front — .e. result went form.
code: race <- finishers |>   left_join(ratings_flat, by = "zwid")  race |> count(is.na(zr_current))   # how many finishers had no ZR rating? race |>   filter(!is.na(zr_current)) |>   group_by(category) |>   summarise(     n       = dplyr::n(),     rho     = cor(zr_current, position, method = "spearman"),     .groups = "drop"   ) library(ggplot2)  race |>   filter(!is.na(zr_current)) |>   ggplot(aes(zr_current, position, colour = category)) +   geom_point(alpha = 0.8) +   geom_smooth(method = "lm", se = FALSE, linewidth = 0.5) +   scale_y_reverse() +                     # position 1 at the top   labs(x = "ZwiftRacing rating (pre-race)", y = "Finishing position",        colour = "Category",        title = sprintf("Race %d: rating vs finish", race_id)) +   theme_minimal()

text: Nested JSON arrives list-columns:
code: library(zwiftverse)  ## Zwift game API ---------------------------------------------------- za  <- zwift_auth()                    # token auto-refreshes me  <- zwift_profile(za)               # your profile (one-row tibble) oth <- zwift_profile(za, 1234567)      # another rider's public profile act <- zwift_activities(za, limit = Inf)   # whole history, auto-paged fol <- zwift_followers(za)             # all followers (auto-paged) res <- zwift_event_results(za, 5795672)  # official results, all subgroups ent <- zwift_event_entrants(za, 5795672) # sign-ups, all subgroups wld <- zwift_riders_in_world(za, 1)    # roster currently in Watopia raw <- zwift_get(za, "/api/profiles/me/activities/", list(limit = 5))  # escape hatch  ## ZwiftPower -------------------------------------------------------- zp   <- zp_set_cookie(zp_session(), "PASTE_phpbb3_lswlk_sid")  # robust path # zp <- zp_login(zp_session())                                 # or SSO (brittle) res  <- zp_result(zp, 3590800)         # finishers team <- zp_team(zp, 456) fts  <- zp_sprints(zp, 3590800)  ## ZwiftRacing.app --------------------------------------------------- zr <- zr_client() r1 <- zr_rider(zr, 1234567)                  # vELO rating in velo$race lg <- zr_rider_overview(zr, 1234567)         # legacy ratings: live / max30 / max90 rr <- zr_rider_results(zr, 1234567, days = 90) ev <- zr_result(zr, 5800908)                 # one row per rider, all pens cm <- zr_club_riders(zr, 456)                # all pages rb <- zr_riders(zr, c(1234567, 2345678))     # one request per rider (no v2 batch) library(tidyr) zr_rider(zr, 1234567) |> hoist(velo, velo_race = "race")

title: Low-level ZwiftRacing.app GET — zr_get
text: zr_rider(): rider's current profile: vELO rating (velo$race, velo$factors), race counts (race$finishes/wins/podiums/dnfs), power, points, phenotype club. zr_rider_overview(): Rider overview, including legacy ZwiftRacing ratings (legacyRatings$live/max30/max90) rating history. zr_rider_results(): rider's race results last days days. One row per race (nested event, place, race, velo, legacy objects, flattened dotted column names). zr_rider_ranking(): rider's ranking / points last days days. zr_rider_velo(): rider's vELO rating history last days days. zr_rider_power(): rider's power curve, efforts FTP estimate. zr_riders(): Several riders' profiles, one row . API v2 batch endpoint, makes one (throttled, cached) request per rider; riders error (e.g. found / opted ) dropped warning. zr_event(): Event metadata (route, distance, pens summary stats). zr_result(): Race results event: one row per rider across pens, pen column. Includes position, category, time, power (wkg*), ratings (ratingBefore, rating, ratingDelta, riderVelo.race). zr_club(): Club summary (name, colours, rider counts). zr_club_riders(): Club members ratings. Paging happens automatically. activity_id Zwift activity id. event_id Zwift event id. subgroup_id Event subgroup id (zwift_event_subgroups()). participation Entrant filter passed API; "signed_up" value verified work. world_id World id (1 = Watopia host world).

title: Low-level Zwift GET — zwift_get
text: zwift_profile(): rider's profile ("" Zwift id). zwift_activities(): rider's activities, newest first. limit total wanted: values server's page size (50) fetched page page bound; limit = Inf fetches whole history. zwift_activity(): single activity id. zwift_followers(): rider's followers (auto-paged, 200 per request). zwift_followees(): Riders rider follows (auto-paged, 200 per request). zwift_rideons(): Ride Ons activity. zwift_give_rideon(): Give Ride (POST). Returns raw response. zwift_event(): event id. zwift_event_subgroups(): event's subgroups (pens / categories): one row , id (subgroup id used results entrants functions), subgroupLabel (, B, ...), start time route. zwift_subgroup_results(): Official Zwift race results one subgroup, finishing order (rank), auto-paged (50 per request). Nested objects flattened: activityData.*, criticalP.*, sensorData.*, profileData.*, scoreHistory.*. zwift_event_results(): Race results every subgroup event, bound one tibble leading subgroup label column. zwift_subgroup_entrants(): Riders signed one subgroup (auto-paged). zwift_event_entrants(): Sign-ups every subgroup event, leading subgroup label column. zwift_worlds(): List active worlds. zwift_riders_in_world(): Roster riders currently world. Live position/power protobuf /relay/worlds/{id}/players/{id}; JSON endpoint returns roster .

what: zwiftverse: Tidy httr2 Clients for the Zwift, ZwiftPower and ZwiftRacing.app APIs — zwiftverse-package
title: zwiftverse: Tidy httr2 Clients for the Zwift, ZwiftPower and ZwiftRacing.app APIs — zwiftverse-package
text: Reverse-engineered, unofficial R clients three Zwift-ecosystem APIs: Zwift game API (us--rly101.zwift.com), ZwiftPower ZwiftRacing.app. Typed wrappers return tibbles; low-level accessors reach unwrapped endpoints; -disk TTL cache avoids re-fetching stable data. None official APIs - reverse-engineered may break upstream change.
